title: Lonesome Arnold
description: Arnold is a lonely man without a friend in the world. He’s ready to move on, but maybe his decision has come too soon.
quote: The cruel rope brought life and a friend, instead of death!
altHero: Arnold with a noose around his neck, tied to a tree branch, but the rope is too long so he is standing on the ground unharmed
alt1: Arnold hears a sound, a dog nearby
alt2: Arnold and the dog see a woman stuck on a branch at the edge of a cliff
